preconditions.description: The number of balls n, number of swaps m, and initial position k are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(swaps) == m and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in swaps)
preconditions.description: There are exactly m swaps, each involving two distinct positions within the valid range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: len(output_positions) == n and all(isinstance(v, int) and (v == -1 or 0 <= v <= m) for v in output_positions)
postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly n integers, where each is either -1 (impossible) or a count between 0 and m.

postconditions.expression: all((output_positions[i-1] == -1) == (i not in reachable_positions) for i in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: For each position i, the output is -1 if and only if the special ball cannot reach position i through any subset of the given swaps.

postconditions.expression: all((output_positions[i-1] == min_fakes[i-1]) for i in range(1, n+1) if i in reachable_positions)
postconditions.description: For each reachable position i, the output value is the minimum number of swaps that must be faked (skipped) so that the special ball ends at position i.
